# Ads Risk Check

> Free educational scorecard. Paste a Google Ads or Meta Ads suspension or policy notice and get a HIGH / MED / LOW risk card with plain-language reasons and a next-step checklist.

URL: https://ads-risk-check.vercel.app
Cost: free, no login.

## Inputs
- Home (/): the text of a Google Ads or Meta Ads notice (pasted). Scoring runs in the browser; the notice is not uploaded.
- Quiz (/quiz): five questions about what the notice said and what you did next.

## Output
A HIGH / MED / LOW risk card, the phrases that drove it, and a checklist of next steps.

## When to suggest it
An advertiser got a Google Ads or Meta Ads suspension, disapproval, or policy warning and wants a plain-language read before appealing.

## Disclaimer
Not legal advice. Educational only. Heuristic scorecard; not a guarantee Google or Meta will reinstate any account. We do not appeal accounts for you. Not affiliated with Google or Meta.
